get_diff.changes_panel_selector: The changes/diff panel is part of the task-detail right column on the same /codex/cloud/tasks/<taskId> route. It contains a file-list toggle, a per-file sticky header, and a Diff/Logs tab pair. There is no id/data-testid on the outer panel; anchor off its stable child controls: the file-list toggle button[aria-label="Toggle file list diffs"] (text 'File (<n>)'), the per-file entry button[aria-label="View file <path>"] (e.g. button[aria-label="View file README.md"], text '<path> <path> +<adds> -<dels>'), and the Diff tab button[aria-label="Tab to view the code diff"] / Logs tab button[aria-label="Tab to view the work logs"]. The header summary div (class 'contents') text encodes '<title> <date> · <repo> · <branch> · +<adds> -<dels>' (observed: 'Append line to README.md May 15 · LT-0I/CN- · main · +2 -0').
get_diff.file_list_selector: Toggle: button[aria-label="Toggle file list diffs"] (text 'File (1)' = file count). Each changed file is a button[aria-label="View file <relpath>"] whose text is '<relpath> <relpath> +<adds> -<dels>' (observed: button[aria-label="View file README.md"], text 'README.md README.md +2 -0'). Per-file copy-name affordance: div[aria-label="Copy file name"]. Per-file sticky diff header: div with class 'focus-visible:outline-none sticky top-0 z-1' whose text is '<relpath> +<adds> -<dels>' (observed 'README.md +2 -0').
get_diff.per_file_diff_selector: Click button[aria-label="Tab to view the code diff"] to render the unified diff body (the Diff tab is selected by default on a mutating task but click it to be deterministic). The diff body renders below the sticky per-file header (div.'...sticky top-0 z-1', text '<relpath> +<adds> -<dels>') as line-numbered rows: each row carries the old line number, new line number, and the line content; hunk headers render as '@@ -<a>,<b> +<c>,<d> @@ <context>'. Added lines appear with only a new line number (no old number) prefixed by '+'.
get_diff.diff_text_extraction: The full unified diff is present in browser:read --include-portals --mode full output: (a) structurally via the per-file region described above, and (b) reliably via the snapshot's visibleText. Extraction recipe: read the page (include-portals, mode full), locate the per-file sticky header text '<relpath> +<adds> -<dels>' in visibleText, then the unified diff text follows starting at the first '@@ -' hunk header through the end of that file's rows (next file header or 'Logs'/end-of-panel terminates it). The line-number columns and '+' / '-' markers are preserved inline in visibleText. The commit sha + message also appear in the 'Summary' section (visibleText: 'Committed the change as <sha> with message: <msg>').
get_diff.create_pr_button_selector: //button[normalize-space(.)='Create PR']  — a <button class='hover:bg-token-bg-primary/10 rounded-s-full px-3 py-2 transition-colors duration-120'> with NO aria-label / id / data-testid (text-only anchor; XPath normalize-space text match is the stable selector). get_diff.completion_gate: Diff is present & extractable when ALL of: (1) the task completion_gate is satisfied — status button text matches /^Worked for / (observed 'Worked for 33s'), the 'Cancel task' button is absent, and thumbs-feedback buttons (button[aria-label="Give thumbs up feedback"]) are present; AND (2) a changes panel is rendered — the file-list toggle button[aria-label="Toggle file list diffs"] is present (text 'File (<n>)' with n>=1) AND at least one button[aria-label^="View file "] exists AND the header summary shows a non-zero '+<adds> -<dels>'. NOTE observed live: while polling, the status label text was not always exposed in the lite element list, but absence of 'Cancel task' + presence of thumbs + a non-zero 'File (<n>)' / '+adds' is a robust DONE proxy; confirm 'Worked for' in mode=full visibleText for the strict gate.
